subject: Hosted eval: quickstart, rate limits & deployment checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@medbridge.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted eval: quickstart, rate limits & deployment checklist

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you earlier — thanks for the time and the walkthrough of MedBridge's inference needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Recap of what you told us
- Primary need: clinical summarization & triage for intake forms (some PHI present).
- Target throughput: ~50 requests/sec at peak.
- Latency target: p50 < 250ms, p95 as low as possible.
- Concern: data residency and contractual controls (BAA, SOC2).

2) Deployment options — high level (to help you decide)
- Hosted API (fastest): Redwood-managed endpoints, per-token billing, no infra for you. Default quotas and rate limits apply; we can run a 48–72hr pilot under your workload to validate latency/throughput. SOC 2 in place; for PHI we typically recommend Dedicated or Private depending on contractual needs (see below).
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools in our tenancy. Predictable throughput, isolation from other tenants, options for stricter contractual controls and data isolation. Faster to stand up than Private but still needs a capacity lead time.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): customer-controlled network, KMS/HSM integrations, BAA & strict data residency possible. Longest lead time (legal + infra).

3) Hosted-specific quickstart & rate-limit notes
- Endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (and /v1/chat for chat flows).
- Default per-account limits: ~120 requests/minute and token throughput ~600 tokens/sec (these are configurable for pilots). We return standard headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset.
- Streaming and function-calling supported on Hosted.

4) Proposed next steps
- You: confirm whether you want to validate on Hosted first (fastest) or prefer to pursue Dedicated/Private right away for PHI.
- Us: if Hosted pilot accepted, we spin up a 48hr performance pilot using your load profile (attach sample). We provide temporary API keys, a test workspace, and a short runbook.
- Legal/procurement: Marissa will follow up on BAA/procurement steps if you indicate PHI scope.

I attached our Hosted quickstart and the SLA summary. If helpful I can also schedule a 30-min session with Lauren (SE) to map expected cost and the exact load profile.

Thanks —
Jonas
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf, SLA-summary.pdf
From: Elena Morales <elena@medbridge.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medbridge.ai
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted eval: quickstart, rate limits & deployment checklist

Thanks Jonas — this is a helpful summary. A few clarifying Qs before we lock in a pilot: 

- PHI scope: some of the intake forms contain limited PHI. We are required to have a BAA in place for any vendor that handles PHI. Is BAA available on Hosted or only for Private/Dedicated?
- Latency/throughput: can Hosted realistically hit 50 RPS with p50 < 250ms for a 2k-token average payload? If not, we will need Dedicated.
- Rate limit behavior: what happens on burst traffic (2x-3x for short periods)? Do you queue, reject 429s, or auto-scale?

If Hosted looks feasible we'll do the 48hr pilot — otherwise we need pricing for Dedicated capacity and a rough SLA that includes latency targets.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, MedBridge Health
elena@medbridge.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@medbridge.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted eval: quickstart, rate limits & deployment checklist

Hi Elena — Lauren (SE) here, jumping in with technical detail so you can decide. Short answers up front: 

- BAA: Hosted does not automatically include a BAA. We can offer a BAA but for most PHI use-cases customers prefer Dedicated or Private so contractual and network isolation are straightforward. We can have Marissa start the BAA conversation if you want to try Hosted under BAA, but note there are additional controls we require (logging, retention, etc.).

- Throughput & latency: 50 RPS at 2k tokens is non-trivial. On Hosted, achievable latency depends on model choice and load profile. For example: using an optimized quantized Llama-family model we typically see p50 ~120–240ms at 50 RPS on our high-throughput nodes; larger encoder-decoder models can be higher. Hosted autoscaling helps, but cold-starts and very large context lengths increase p95. 

- Burst behavior: default behavior is to auto-scale where capacity exists and enforce soft rate limits; clients will see 429 when account-level quotas are hit. For pilot we can temporarily relax limits and provision burst capacity to hit 2x–3x short bursts. We also support token-level shaping and request concurrency controls in the client to smooth bursts.

- Recommendation: run the 48hr Hosted pilot with your exact 2k-token payloads and load profile (attach). We'll provision elevated quota for the window and collect latency percentiles + token-costs. If pilot shows consistent inability to meet p50 targets, we'll discuss Dedicated sizing (reserved GPUs) and provide an apples-to-apples cost/latency estimate.

Quickstart for pilot (high level):
1) We create a test workspace for MedBridge and provide a scoped API key.
2) You run your load generator against POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (we'll provide a sample curl & k6 config).
3) We'll stream metrics to the shared dashboard and run a sync at 24h with profiling artifacts.

I've attached a sample load profile (medbridge-load-profile.json) and a k6 snippet we use. If you give the go-ahead, Jonas will kick off provisioning and Marissa will start the procurement/BAA thread.

Lauren
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: medbridge-load-profile.json
From: Elena Morales <elena@medbridge.ai>

Cc: procurement@medbridge.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted eval: quickstart, rate limits & deployment checklist

Thanks all — we want to proceed with the 48hr Hosted pilot to validate latency and cost. A couple of administrative items before kickoff: 

- Pilot window: please schedule kickoff on Tue, 26 May (09:00 PT) — we'll have an engineer on standby to run the load.
- API keys: send scoped test keys that can be rotated and limited to the pilot workspace.
- Procurement/legal: procurement@medbridge.ai will need a short statement of work and the standard SLA; they will not sign a BAA immediately but want to review terms.
- Billing/credits: can you confirm whether free pilot credits apply or if we will be billed for the pilot (we prefer credits).

If these are OK we'll confirm calendar invites. Looking forward to seeing real numbers.

Best,
Elena
